references.role: painted brushwork anchor for the environment; characters follow the turnaround's look
references.subject: jimothy

perspectiveDescription: high three-quarter isometric view from above, the camera looking down on the yard at roughly 30 to 35 degrees, ground plane receding to the upper right

stevie.description: Stevie, a lean, upright, long-bodied adult raccoon with a dark eye mask, cream muzzle and brows, rounded pale-rimmed ears and a full tail with five dark rings

jimothy.description: Jimothy, a short-spined, round, hunched and chubby raccoon with a very fluffy coat and a big fluffy banded tail

notes: rendering: painterly; characters in naturalistic illustrated realism like Stevie's approved turnaround (soft, believable fur and anatomy, high quality, never photographic and never heavily painterly); the environment a touch more painterly than the characters, never photo-accurate; never cartoon-flat
texture: characters with fine, soft, naturalistic fur and fur strands at every silhouette edge, no visible brushwork; environment with soft visible brushwork and a wet sheen on stone and wood
detail: high on the characters' faces, masks and banded tails; medium on fur bodies; lower on background foliage
lighting: warm amber lantern and window light against cool blue-grey dusk and rain; soft rim light separating fur from the background
colour: full colour, soft alpha; never pixel art
no text, logos or watermarks in the art
